1.27 Start with supported performance maintenance

For ordinary performance trouble, begin with Adobe’s guidance: adequate free space, catalog/previews on appropriate fast storage, intentional preview sizes, catalog optimization, and the relevant cache and Sync settings. Keep previews available during recovery rather than deleting them reflexively. Adobe: optimize performance.

The advanced recipes above answer observed mechanisms that routine maintenance did not explain. They are useful only when exact current evidence qualifies the mechanism. A measured API body, copy benchmark, native mapping transition, file publication, and server completion are different results. Report the one you actually verified.
